summary: Observation: original FS-GG/FS.GG.Templates 40121103111/a1 failed at ProviderTool current-d5-backend-check because validateCurrentD5Backend required a work/d5-default/ entry that only its synthetic fixture had (SDD 2.4.0 Quint-v2 author writes readiness/<work>/ and the model path only); it had already passed the hosted AppArmor-lifted namespace gate, SDK/Go/packages and receiver checks. After Templates#778 and an offline replay of the receiver-side checkers on the real retained trees (exact quint 0.32.0, lmt sha 37e0b036, SDD 2.4.0), the rerun 40124373443/a1 (main 4a6a3360, Root-delegated single dispatch, T0 2026-10-24T19:14:19Z) ended receiver-checks-complete: raw-omitted, provider-omitted and wizard-omitted receiver checks passed, and the default quint-specification-v1 author, inspect and wrong-profile refusal (blocked, QUINT-PROFILE-IDENTITY, snapshots unchanged) passed for both typed receivers; 44 managed groups, 42 succeeded plus the 2 expected refusals, contained and removed. Lesson: model synthetic receiver fixtures on real public-tool output, and replay unreached checkers against retained real trees before spending an original. Limits: n=1; this is the owner's evidence readback, not Root acceptance; 3 of 43 receivers evidenced, the raw-plus-42 matrix, browser/AT scope and holds remain open.
title: First D5 rehearsal original failed on a fixture layout; the rerun with the corrected checker passed 3 of 3 rehearsal receivers
